antecedent.K4Q_decision_diversity_failure: Only reaching had differing DEV best actions; pushing and picking remained constant in K4Q.

independent_source.family: public open-source MiniGrid interactive navigation benchmarks
independent_source.note: No CausalWorld simulator or original K4I–K4Q contexts are used.

worlds.observation: Original minigrid.wrappers.FullyObsWrapper with complete PUBLIC grid['image'] only; parse agent coordinate+direction, goal position, wall cells; no env.unwrapped.agent_pos, grid or hidden layout reads by any controller.
worlds.meanings: 0 left,1 right,2 forward. Other public MiniGrid action IDs unused.
worlds.FIT_experiences: 24 real exploration episodes/family, max episode horizon as constructor. Exploration controller chooses actions through seeded uniform random actions 0..2, seed 810000 + 1000*family_index + world_seed. Actual observations, transitions and rewards stored.
worlds.FIT_scope: Learn a single shared robot motion model across both families; train public-feature tabular Q using the exact same source transitions. No task seed encoded in model inputs.
worlds.FIT_model: Empirically fit the modal observed orientation change per action 0 and1, and forward positional displacement per orientation for action2 whenever the PUBLIC cell ahead is walkable; source also records blocked-forward no-op. No hard-coded displacement in learned model.
conventional_controls: learned forward-dynamics + breadth-first shortest public-grid planner
perfect source-semantic public-grid shortest-path planner (conventional oracle upper reference, no secret env state)
tabular Q-learning from same FIT experiences
worlds.Q_model: Tabular Q with gamma0.95, alpha0.25, seed-invariant public-state abstract key (family, sign(dx_goal),sign(dy_goal),distance bucket0..3,orientation,public front-blocked). One step online TD(0) update over each recorded FIT transition, no heldout fitting or tuned hyperparameters. Episode success reward original sparse MiniGrid, all updates using FIT only.
worlds.planner: Breadth-first path planning over (x,y,orientation) using full PUBLIC grid walls and goal. Learned planner generates transitions only from FIT learned modal action dynamics; expert planner uses published MiniGrid direction constants as an upper-bound, not a fitted policy. Replan at every step from current public grid.
worlds.fit_gate: Both families at least 16 distinct public reset observations; FIT observes all three action IDs, each agent orientation 0..3 for unblocked forward and at least one blocked forward; modal empirical turns are one left and right, modal forward displacement matches public documented convention; else stop WITHOUT consuming CHECK or DEV. FIT model/ Q state digests fixed and JSON roundtrip verified.
worlds.protocol_custody: No source seed, model parameters, run horizon, threshold or model selection changed after first FIT or DEV output. No reruns on consumed DEV; if engineering bug before physics first-use, fix and preserve commit trail.

evaluation.policy_budget: Each method independently gets a fresh seeded environment and at most the same constructor max_steps for each FIT-heldout world seed. Same observation permissions and FIT source for every fitted policy.
evaluation.CHECK_first: 4 fresh CHECK worlds/family and 8 DEV worlds/family are fully executed only after FIT gate passes. Do not alter models after CHECK. CHK and DEV scores isolated.
evaluation.metrics: Per policy/family/seed: actual success from terminated+positive reward, cumulative real reward, steps, public-reset/goal SHA, first action, source episode initial wall-map SHA; per-step full original public reward/transition trace hash; full runner CPU, wall, peak RSS; per method evaluation CPU and checkpoint bytes. 2 Python processes science-match exactly excluding timings.
evaluation.positive: Both distinct families must have >=2 different expert-optimal first actions on DEV (public planner action-choice diversity), and learned dynamics+BFS policy must succeed on >=6 of 8 DEV episodes per family, achieve success rate >= seeded random +0.40 for each family, and earn >=0.75 times public expert mean reward for each family. Learned model must never use heldout transitions in fitting. Tabular Q, random and fixed outcomes preserved even if negative.
evaluation.independent_replication: 2 fresh Python OS processes on ONE GitHub-hosted Linux runner source-compare; this is not independent host or scientific first-use.
evaluation.stop_rules: If source identity or FIT action transition support fails, or first source episodes fail, report a bounded negative and do not consume holdout; if heldout randomized starts provide no diverse expert-optimal action, NO_GO despite model-based success; no favorable-seed filtering or resampling.
evaluation.advance: Qualifying K4R means the *source benchmark* has genuine public action transitions and conventionally learnable context-dependent control in two families. It DOES NOT establish unfamiliar-family transfer of a novel native learner; that requires independently preregistered subsequent science.
